Source audience hints: admin_clients. Verify authorized/admin/owner/restricted/revoked sockets and initial/repeat/changed/failure transitions; literal test mentions below are discovery leads only.
exceptions: Named tests are assertion leads, not complete coverage or a current execution claim. Missing source/client state and failure variants remain required.

invariants.contract: Deleting a share (DELETE /api/share/mediaitem/:id) and the scheduled expiry of a timed share each emit exactly one share_closed to every authenticated admin socket through SocketAuthority.adminEmitter. The event has one argument: the closed share's client JSON (id, mediaItemId, mediaItemType, slug, expiresAt, createdAt, updatedAt, isDownloadable). Non-admin and unauthenticated sockets never receive it, refused deletes and later reads of an already-expired share emit nothing, and each distinct share id gets its own event.
exceptions: Audience is admin sockets only (SocketAuthority.adminEmitter), not all authorized clients.
force is not applicable: no share management or public consumer route has a force, hard or refresh/override mode.
